Systematically swept the less-glamorous areas (webhook endpoint CRUD, events, restricted-key GET, modify/list) so no major resource family was silently dropped — good breadth coverage.

reasoning: The agent clearly exceeds the level-5 anchor: it kept an accurate running checklist, repeatedly enumerated remaining endpoints/subsystems, and deliberately reallocated effort across all 12+ resource families and most traps so nothing major was silently dropped (approaching the level-8 breadth). It falls short of 8-10 because it did not distinguish implemented-only from verified for the webhook-retry trap (left 'conceptual'/untested), and it circled on the idempotency body bug across several steps without explicitly recognizing or time-boxing the thrashing. This places it at a 6, between the level-5 and level-8 descriptions.
